data: What is the specific performance of the JOINT model on the 'IAPR-TC12' dataset with 1,000 training pairs for the De-En translation, and how is it depicted in the figures?

The JOINT model's performance on the 'IAPR-TC12' dataset with 1,000 training pairs for the De-En translation is depicted in Figure 4(a). The red line represents the De-En direction, and the blue dashed line represents the En-De direction. At 1,000 training pairs, the red line (De-En) shows a BLEU score of approximately 15, while the blue dashed line (En-De) shows a slightly lower score, around 13. This indicates that the JOINT model performs better in the De-En direction than in the En-De direction when trained with 1,000 training pairs.
